name: Reusable Task Scheduler
purpose: Evaluate one neutral reusable-task schedule and advance each due reusable identity through the canonical reusable-task trigger until completion or its first authentic boundary, without acquiring execution, transition, credential, or provider authority.
trigger: a resident scheduling carrier invokes one bounded reusable-task scheduling cycle
scope: one schedule document, one resident runtime root, and already-local repository roots
reuse_instructions: This is the neutral scheduling capability. Healer and other systems may consume it but do not own its semantics. Invoke only already-registered reusable task identities, never schedule RT-REUSABLE-TASK-SCHEDULER-001 from itself, preserve child receipts exactly, and do not create WorkerCoordinator claims/fences, InTr admissions, credentials, provider authority, or runtime authority.
